## Full negative answer after mathematical repair

Question2 in Laghribi's OWR5/2016 contribution (problem30003045, printed251) is false at its allowed index n=1. The degree-four exponent-two example uses a genuine separable quadratic extension and a binary bilinear Pfister form remaining anisotropic over L. Its universal norm/residue argument excludes the full sum of all three kernels. The positive degree-one cohomology boundary is addressed separately.

The auxiliary exponent-one shortcut was repaired: it gives membership in the sum of the inseparable and separable kernels; it does not drop a base-field du term. Exact antecedent credit is strengthened: the class literally specializes ALO2019 Definition1.3/Lemma3.1/Theorem1.4, published J.Algebra542(2020),249–276. The mixed generator and its vanishing mechanism are not claimed new. No firstness/global-openness certificate is asserted; inaccessible adjacent journal bodies remain unresolved in the audit.

Root and three mathematical review families checked the main proof, and the concrete auxiliary correction was independently verified. Three additional primary priority approaches are complete. Initial families had parent conversation context available; this is not blind rediscovery. The new standard-library diagnostics and baselines are distributed and run in ordinary/optimized modes, with18 actual wrong-result failures. Original absent13/25 programs are not represented as rerun. All material is unrefereed and extensively AI-assisted, with no external human peer review or formal certification.

This repaired edition supersedes the historical no-correction framing. Original input/audit bytes remain available at head99f43020e142374629848e97113d354b43fd9f8e and the dedicated program audit. Complete-package review, preprint publication and tracker/merge are separate gates; the PR remains a draft during preparation. No copied third-party source bodies are included.

## Complete-package review repair

The first fresh no-history whole-package review found no mathematical defect, but found a missing documentation target, an intermediate proof checksum mislabeled current, and incomplete rejection of directory symlinks. The diagnostic reference now points to COUNTEREXAMPLE.md; the current proof identity is explicit; the flat PR runner rejects every unlisted entry, directory and symlink. The enclosing publication runner/builder additionally reject symlink ancestors inside distribution roots. A small Milne statement-label citation was corrected in the preprint. No mathematical conclusion or proof body changed. The final clean-review count is reset after these repairs; publication remains gated.
